dtm.source: MGS MOLA MEGDR 128 px/deg median topography (about 463 m bins), metres above the areoid, mapping phase 1999-2001, PDS Geosciences Node
dtm.method: bilinear between MOLA bin centres at 30 m cell centres; a cell is no-data when its nearest bin holds no laser shot (the archive fills those bins by interpolation)

fill.use: 3D display surface only, includes interpolated MOLA bins; routing uses arc_dtm_30m.i16

rough.method: HRSC nadir brightness: subtract 9 x 9 px (110 m) mean, RMS over 5 x 5 px (60 m), sampled at cell centres, scaled 5th..95th percentile to 0..254
